label: School and Education
heading: Egyptian Arabic School and Education — 43 Words

examples.arabic: كل كلمة قالتها أو سمعتها كانت جزء من يومها الطبيعي في القاهرة، بتضيف لجمال وتنوع الحياة اليومية هناك.
examples.english: Every word she said or heard was a part of her normal day in Cairo, adding to the beauty and diversity of daily life there.
examples.transliteration: Kol kelma 2aletha aw seme3etha kanet goz' men yomha el-ṭabi3i fi el-Qahira, betḍeef le-gamal we tanawwo3 el-ḥaya el-yawmeyya henāk.
examples.storyTitle: Mona's Journey in Khan el-Khalili: A Morning Full of Greetings

examples.arabic: دلوقتي احنا هنذاكر عشان الامتحان بكره
examples.english: Now we will study for the exam tomorrow
examples.transliteration: delwaety ehna hanezaker ashan el emtehan bokra

examples.arabic: فكر في أبوه اللي كان بيعلمه "لازم تكون واضح يا ابني"، وبص على الوادل اللي باين عليه بيروح الشغل كل يوم ده، وقرر إنه لازم يطلب حالا عشان لازم ندرس للامتحان.
examples.english: He thought of his father, who always taught him, "You must be clear, my son," and looked at the waiter who clearly goes to work every day, then decided he must order now because they must study for the exam.
examples.transliteration: Fakkar fi abooh elly kan beya'allimoh "lazim takoon wadeh ya ebny," w bass 'ala el-wadil elly bayen 'aleih beyrouh esh-shoghl koll yom dah, w qarar enno lazim yetlob halan 'ashan lazim nedres lel-emtehan.

examples.arabic: علي شرح له مشكلته، وعمو محمود رد: "بالظبط! أنا معايا كتاب الدرس اللي أنت عايزه ده، خده. أنا بروح الشغل كل يوم بعد القهوة. أنت لازم تدرس للامتحان كويس جداً." علي رد: "ألف شكر يا عمو! مع السلامة دلوقتي، أنا لازم أروح أذاكر بيه فوراً!"
examples.english: Aly explained his problem to him, and Uncle Mahmoud replied: "Exactly! I have the lesson book you want, take it. I go to work every day after the coffeehouse. You must study very well for the exam." Aly responded: "A thousand thanks, Uncle! Goodbye for now, I must go study with it immediately!"
examples.transliteration: Aly sharah lu mushkeltu, w ammo Mahmoud radd: "Bel-zabt! Ana ma'aya ketab el-dars elli enta ayezuh da, khoduh. Ana baruh el-shoghl kull yom ba'd el-ahwa. Enta lazim tedrus lel-emtihan kwayyes geddan." Aly radd: "Alf shokr ya ammo! Ma'a el-salama delwa'ty, ana lazim aruh azaker beih fawran!"
examples.storyTitle: A Book's Journey in Khan el-Khalili

examples.arabic: وكل مرة بتخلص اجابة بيقول شكرا وبيسأل سؤال جديد
examples.english: And every time an answer finishes, he says "Thank you" and asks a new question.
examples.transliteration: W kol marra betkhallas igaba biyo'ul shukran w biyes'al so'al gideed

examples.arabic: امي كانت بترد بصبر على كل سؤال وبيضحكوا مع بعض كتير
examples.english: My mother answered patiently every question, and they laughed a lot together.
examples.transliteration: Ommy kanet betrodd be-sabr 'ala kol so'al w beyedhakkoo ma' ba'd kiteer.

examples.arabic: الاب كان بيحاول يجاوب بس ليلى كانت بتسأل سؤال تاني على طول
examples.english: The father tried to answer, but Layla would ask another question right away.
examples.transliteration: El ab kan bihayawel yegaweb bas Layla kanet betsa'al so'al tani ala tool

examples.arabic: دلوقتي احنا هنذاكر عشان الامتحان بكره
examples.english: Now we will study for the exam tomorrow
examples.transliteration: delwaety ehna hanezaker ashan el emtehan bokra

examples.arabic: بعد الامتحان حسيت اني تعبانة وكنت عاوزة اسمع مزيكا
examples.english: After the exam, I felt tired and wanted to listen to music
examples.transliteration: Ba3d el emte7an 7asseit enny ta3bana w kont 3awza asma3 mazika

examples.arabic: المشكلة دي ليها تاريخ طويل من سنين كتيرة.
examples.english: This problem has a long history from many years ago.
examples.transliteration: El-moshkila di liha tarikh tawil min sinin ketira.
examples.storyTitle: War News on the Day of Eid

examples.arabic: هي كانت محتاجة كتاب تاريخ نادر لمشروعها؛ أهو ده هو؟
examples.english: She needed a rare history book for her project; could this be it?
examples.transliteration: Heya kanet mehtaga ketab tareekh nader le mashroo'ha; aho dah howa?
examples.storyTitle: The Lost Book on El Moez Street

examples.arabic: كنت بأسأل لو عندك كتاب "تاريخ القاهرة" للمقريزي، يعني هو نادر شوية.
examples.english: I was asking if you have the book "History of Cairo" by Al-Maqrizi, I mean, it's a bit rare.
examples.transliteration: Kunt ba'sa'al law 3andak kitab "Tarikh el-Qahira" lel-Maqrizi, ya3ni howa nader shwayya.

examples.arabic: منى بصت حواليها، "لأ، مش معقول، إيه ده؟ هو الأستاذ كريم لسه هنا؟ أنتَ منين يا أستاذ؟"
examples.english: Mona looked around, "No, unbelievable, what is this? Is Professor Karim still here? Where are you from, Professor?"
examples.transliteration: Mona baset 7awaliha, "La', mesh ma'oul, eh dah? Howa el-ostaz Karim lessa hena? Enta menein ya ostaz?"

examples.arabic: رد وقالي انا رامي زميلك بتاع الجامعة انا دلوقتي بقيت أمريكاني
examples.english: He replied and told me 'I'm Rami, your university colleague. I'm American now.'
examples.transliteration: Radd w qali ana Rami zameelak beta' el gam'a ana delwa'ty ba'eet Amreekani.

examples.arabic: هي قررت تشتريه فورًا وترجّعُه ليه في الجامعة بكرة.
examples.english: She decided to buy it immediately and return it to him at the university tomorrow.
examples.transliteration: Heya qarraret teshtareeh fawran we teragga'o leeh fel gam'a bokra.
examples.storyTitle: The Lost Book on El Moez Street

examples.arabic: مريم، طالبة الجامعة العنيدة اللي عندها خمسة وعشرين سنة، كانت بتدور بقالها ساعة في وكالة البلح على كتاب "أصول الهندسة المعمارية القديمة" ومش لاقياه خالص بالسعر اللي معاها.
examples.english: Maryam, the stubborn 25-year-old university student, had been searching for an hour in Wekalet el-Balah for the book "Principles of Ancient Architecture" and couldn't find it at all for the price she had.
examples.transliteration: Maryam, talibet el-gameaa el-aneeda elli 3andaha khamsa we 3eshreen sana, kanet betdawwar ba'alha sa3a fi Wekalet el-Balah 3ala ketab "Osol el-Handasa el-Me3mareya el-Adeema" we mesh la'yah khales bel-se3r elli ma3aha.

examples.arabic: هي عايزة كتاب "ألف ليلة وليلة" اللي كان بـ ٨٠ جنيه، بس معاها ٥٠ جنيه بس.
examples.english: She wanted "One Thousand and One Nights" book, which was 80 EGP, but she only had 50 EGP.
examples.transliteration: Heya 3ayza ketab "Alf Leila we Leila" elly kan be-80 geneh, bas ma'aha 50 geneh bas.
examples.storyTitle: Mona and the Ataba Market Book

examples.arabic: المدرس القديم كان بيستخدم الكتاب بس
examples.english: The old teacher used only the book.
examples.transliteration: El-modarres el-adeem kan beyestakhdem el-ketab bas

examples.arabic: و فيه راجل كبير ماسك كتاب قديم
examples.english: And there is an old man holding an old book.
examples.transliteration: Wi feeh ragel kibeer mas'ek ketaab adeem

examples.arabic: ريحة الشاي بالنعناع والخشب القديم مالت الجو في قهوة الفيشاوي بالخان الخليلي؛ كريم، طالب جامعي عنده 22 سنة وشوية خجول، كان قاعد بكتاب الدرس بتاعه.
examples.english: The smell of mint tea and old wood filled the air at Ahwet El-Fishawy in Khan el-Khalili; Kareem, a 22-year-old shy university student, sat there with his study book for the lesson.
examples.transliteration: Rihet esh-shay bel-na'na' wel-khashab el-qadeem malet el-gaww fi ahwet el-Fishawy bel-Khan el-Khalili; Kareem, taleb gam'i 'ando 22 sana w shwayet khagul, kan qa'ed be-ketab el-dars beta'o.

examples.arabic: علي، طالب جامعي عنده 22 سنة، واقف قدام مكتبة في خان الخليلي، مجتهد بس أحيانًا بينسى مواعيده. شاف عم حامد، البواب بتاع المحل اللي جنبه، وقال له: "صباح الخير يا عمو! إزيك عامل إيه؟"
examples.english: Aly, a 22-year-old university student, stood in front of a bookstore in Khan el-Khalili, diligent but sometimes forgetting his appointments. He saw Uncle Hamed, the doorman of the shop next to it, and said to him: "Good morning, Uncle! How are you doing?"
examples.transliteration: Aly, taleb gamiey andu 22 sana, waqef oddam maktaba fi Khan el-Khalili, mugtahed bas ahianan biensa mawaidu. Shaf am Hamed, el-bawwab beta el-mahal elli ganbu, w qallu: "Sabah el-kheir ya ammo! Izzayak amel eh?"
examples.storyTitle: A Book's Journey in Khan el-Khalili

examples.arabic: سمير طالب في الجامعه.
examples.english: Samir is a university student.
examples.transliteration: Samir talib fi el-gam'a.

examples.arabic: صاحبي كان بيشرحلي اللعب عشان افهم كل حاجه
examples.english: My friend was explaining the game to me so I could understand everything
examples.transliteration: Sahby kan be-yeshrahly el-la'b ashan afham koll haga

examples.arabic: انا عايزة اروح جامعة القاهرة
examples.english: I want to go to Cairo University.
examples.transliteration: Ana 'ayza arouh gam'et el Qahira.

examples.arabic: رد وقالي انا رامي زميلك بتاع الجامعة انا دلوقتي بقيت أمريكاني
examples.english: He replied and told me 'I'm Rami, your university colleague. I'm American now.'
examples.transliteration: Radd w qali ana Rami zameelak beta' el gam'a ana delwa'ty ba'eet Amreekani.

examples.arabic: هي قررت تشتريه فورًا وترجّعُه ليه في الجامعة بكرة.
examples.english: She decided to buy it immediately and return it to him at the university tomorrow.
examples.transliteration: Heya qarraret teshtareeh fawran we teragga'o leeh fel gam'a bokra.
examples.storyTitle: The Lost Book on El Moez Street

examples.english: Aly explained his problem to him, and Uncle Mahmoud replied: "Exactly! I have the lesson book you want, take it. I go to work every day after the coffeehouse. examples.storyTitle: A Book's Journey in Khan el-Khalili

examples.arabic: ضحك وقالي ايوه عشان اذاكر
examples.english: He laughed and told me 'Yes, for studying.'
examples.transliteration: dehek we ali aywa 'ashaan azaker

examples.arabic: عم حسن قالها: "يا بنتي، معلش، طب خدي الكتاب ده بـ ٥٠ جنيه عشانك."
examples.english: Uncle Hassan told her: "My daughter, never mind, okay take this book for 50 EGP for you."
examples.transliteration: 3amm Hassan al-laha: "Ya benty, ma'lesh, tab khodi el-ketab da be-50 geneh 3ashanak."
examples.storyTitle: Mona and the Ataba Market Book

examples.arabic: المدرس القديم كان بيستخدم الكتاب بس
examples.english: The old teacher used only the book.
examples.transliteration: El-modarres el-adeem kan beyestakhdem el-ketab bas

examples.arabic: الكتاب كان أزرق غامق، بالظبط زي ما أستاذها وصف، بس سعرُه كان مكتوب عشرين جنيه بس.
examples.english: The book was dark blue, exactly as her professor described, but its price was written only twenty pounds.
examples.transliteration: El ketab kan azraq ghame' bilzabt zay ma ostazha wassaf, bas se'ro kan maktoob 'eshreen geneh bas.
examples.storyTitle: The Lost Book on El Moez Street

examples.arabic: شكرا جدا انا فهمت الطريق
examples.english: Thank you very much, I understood the way.
examples.transliteration: Shokran geddan ana fehemt el-taree'.
examples.storyTitle: I Got Lost and Asked for Directions

examples.arabic: بعد كلام كتير هي فهمت إن ذوقي غير ذوقها
examples.english: After a lot of talking, she understood that my taste is different from hers.
examples.transliteration: Ba'd kalam kiteer heyya fahmit inn zo'i gheir zo'ha

examples.arabic: كده فهمت يومي ماشي ازاي ودلوقتي اقدر انزل الشغل
examples.english: This way I understood how my day is going and now I can go down to work.
examples.transliteration: Kedah fahimt yoomi mashi ezayy we delwaʾti aqdar anzil esh-shoghl.

examples.arabic: هي بتفضل تكتب كل حاجة في ورق وانا بستخدم الكمبيوتر والتليفون لكل حاجة
examples.english: She prefers to write everything on paper, while I use the computer and phone for everything.
examples.transliteration: Heya bitfaḍḍal tektib kol ḥaga fi waraq wana bastaḫdem elkombuytar wettelifoun lekoll ḥaga.
examples.storyTitle: A Day at Work: Different Generations

examples.arabic: هي مجبورة تفهم الدرس ده كويس.
examples.english: She has to understand this lesson well.
examples.transliteration: Heya magboura tefham el dars dah kowayes.

examples.arabic: بس انا بذاكر ماده جديده دلوقتي
examples.english: But I am studying a new subject now.
examples.transliteration: Bas ana bazaker madda gedida delwa'ty.
